exercises.instructions: Choose the correct meaning of the proverb.

questions.question: What does 'A leopard cannot change its spots' mean?
options: People cannot change their fundamental nature
Leopards have unique patterns
Animals can adapt to new environments
questions.answer: People cannot change their fundamental nature
questions.explanation: 'A leopard cannot change its spots' means people cannot change their fundamental nature. 'A leopard cannot change its spots' ဆိုတာ လူတစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ မူလသဘာဝကို ပြောင်းလဲလို့မရဘူး။

questions.question: What does 'A fool and his money are soon parted' mean?
options: Rich people are generous
A foolish person quickly loses their money
Money is hard to earn
questions.answer: A foolish person quickly loses their money
questions.explanation: 'A fool and his money are soon parted' means a foolish person quickly loses their money. 'A fool and his money are soon parted' ဆိုတာ အသိဥာဏ်နည်းတဲ့လူက ငွေကိုမြန်မြန်ဆုံးရှုံးတတ်တယ်။

questions.question: What does 'A barking dog seldom bites' mean?
options: Dogs are dangerous
People who make loud threats rarely carry them out
Barking is a sign of aggression
questions.answer: People who make loud threats rarely carry them out
questions.explanation: 'A barking dog seldom bites' means people who make loud threats rarely carry them out. 'A barking dog seldom bites' ဆိုတာ အော်ဟစ်ခြိမ်းခြောက်တတ်တဲ့လူက ရှားရှားပါးပါး လုပ်တတ်တယ်။

questions.question: What does 'A mouse may help a lion' mean?
options: Mice are brave animals
Even small or weak beings can help the powerful
Lions need help from others
questions.answer: Even small or weak beings can help the powerful
questions.explanation: 'A mouse may help a lion' means even small or weak beings can help the powerful. 'A mouse may help a lion' ဆိုတာ အားနည်းတဲ့လူက အားကြီးတဲ့လူကို ကူညီနိုင်တယ်။

questions.question: What does 'All that glitters is not gold' mean?
options: Gold is valuable
Something that looks valuable or attractive may not be so
Glittering things are always expensive
questions.answer: Something that looks valuable or attractive may not be so
questions.explanation: 'All that glitters is not gold' means something that looks valuable or attractive may not be so. 'All that glitters is not gold' ဆိုတာ တောက်ပတဲ့အရာအားလုံး ရွှေမဟုတ်ဘူး။

questions.question: What does 'Blood is thicker than water' mean?
options: Blood is denser than water
Family relationships are stronger than other relationships
Blood has special properties
questions.answer: Family relationships are stronger than other relationships
questions.explanation: 'Blood is thicker than water' means family relationships are stronger than other relationships. 'Blood is thicker than water' ဆိုတာ သွေးသားဆက်ဆံက ရေထက်ပိုထူတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Better late than never' mean?
options: Being late is always acceptable
It is better to do something late than not at all
Never being late is important
questions.answer: It is better to do something late than not at all
questions.explanation: 'Better late than never' means it is better to do something late than not at all. 'Better late than never' ဆိုတာ နောက်ကျပေမယ့် မလုပ်တာထက်ပိုကောင်းတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Charity begins at home' mean?
options: Charity organizations should be based at home
One should take care of family first before helping others
Home is the best place to give charity
questions.answer: One should take care of family first before helping others
questions.explanation: 'Charity begins at home' means one should take care of family first before helping others. 'Charity begins at home' ဆိုတာ ကျေးဇူးပြုခြင်းက အိမ်မှာစတင်တယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Don't put all your eggs in one basket' mean?
options: Eggs are fragile
Do not risk everything on a single plan or opportunity
Carry eggs carefully
questions.answer: Do not risk everything on a single plan or opportunity
questions.explanation: 'Don't put all your eggs in one basket' means do not risk everything on a single plan or opportunity. 'Don't put all your eggs in one basket' ဆိုတာ ဥအုန်းအားလုံးကို ခြင်းတစ်ခုထဲမှာ မထားပါနဲ့။

questions.question: What does 'Every cloud has a silver lining' mean?
options: Clouds are silver in color
There is something good in every bad situation
Silver is valuable
questions.answer: There is something good in every bad situation
questions.explanation: 'Every cloud has a silver lining' means there is something good in every bad situation. 'Every cloud has a silver lining' ဆိုတာ မိုးတိမ်တိုင်းရဲ့ ငွေရောင်အစွန်းရှိတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Easy come, easy go' mean?
options: Easy tasks are fun
What is gained easily is lost easily
Life should be easy
questions.answer: What is gained easily is lost easily
questions.explanation: 'Easy come, easy go' means what is gained easily is lost easily. 'Easy come, easy go' ဆိုတာ လွယ်လွယ်ရတာ လွယ်လွယ်ဆုံးရှုံးတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Familiarity breeds contempt' mean?
options: Familiarity is good
Too much closeness leads to a lack of respect
Being familiar with something is bad
questions.answer: Too much closeness leads to a lack of respect
questions.explanation: 'Familiarity breeds contempt' means too much closeness leads to a lack of respect. 'Familiarity breeds contempt' ဆိုတာ ရင်းနှီးမှုက အထင်အမြင်သေးခြင်းကို ဖန်တီးတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Grasp all, lose all' mean?
options: Holding things tightly is good
If you try to hold on to everything, you will lose everything
Having many things is beneficial
questions.answer: If you try to hold on to everything, you will lose everything
questions.explanation: 'Grasp all, lose all' means if you try to hold on to everything, you will lose everything. 'Grasp all, lose all' ဆိုတာ အားလုံးကို ဆွဲကိုင်ရင် အားလုံးဆုံးရှုံးမယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade' mean?
options: Gardens need sunlight
Success requires effort and hard work
Resting is important
questions.answer: Success requires effort and hard work
questions.explanation: 'Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade' means success requires effort and hard work. 'Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade' ဆိုတာ ဥယျာဉ်ကို အရိပ်ထဲမှာ ထိုင်ပြီး ဖန်တီးလို့မရဘူး။

questions.question: What does 'The pen is mightier than the sword' mean?
options: Writing tools are stronger than weapons
Words and ideas have more influence than violence
Pens are made of strong material
questions.answer: Words and ideas have more influence than violence
questions.explanation: 'The pen is mightier than the sword' means words and ideas have more influence than violence. 'The pen is mightier than the sword' ဆိုတာ ဘောပင်က ဓားထက် ပိုအားကြီးတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'The early bird catches the worm' mean?
options: Birds eat worms
Success comes to those who act early and prepare well
Worms are caught in the morning
questions.answer: Success comes to those who act early and prepare well
questions.explanation: 'The early bird catches the worm' means success comes to those who act early and prepare well. 'The early bird catches the worm' ဆိုတာ အစောပိုင်းငှက်က ပုရွက်ဆိတ်ကို ဖမ်းမိတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Prevention is better than cure' mean?
options: Preventing disease is important
It is better to stop something bad from happening than to fix it later
Curing diseases is impossible
questions.answer: It is better to stop something bad from happening than to fix it later
questions.explanation: 'Prevention is better than cure' means it is better to stop something bad from happening than to fix it later. 'Prevention is better than cure' ဆိုတာ ကာကွယ်ခြင်းက ကုသခြင်းထက် ပိုကောင်းတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'Rome was not built in a day' mean?
options: Rome is an old city
Important achievements take time and patience
Building cities is difficult
questions.answer: Important achievements take time and patience
questions.explanation: 'Rome was not built in a day' means important achievements take time and patience. 'Rome was not built in a day' ဆိုတာ ရောမမြို့ကို တစ်နေ့ထဲနဲ့ မဆောက်နိုင်ဘူး။

questions.question: What does 'When in Rome do as Romans do' mean?
options: Visit Rome for tourism
When in a new place, follow the customs of the people there
Roman culture is superior
questions.answer: When in a new place, follow the customs of the people there
questions.explanation: 'When in Rome do as Romans do' means when in a new place, follow the customs of the people there. 'When in Rome do as Romans do' ဆိုတာ ရောမမှာနေရင် ရောမလူတွေလို လုပ်ပါ။

questions.question: What does 'Words cut more than swords' mean?
options: Swords are not dangerous
Hurtful words cause deeper wounds than physical weapons
Words are sharper than swords
questions.answer: Hurtful words cause deeper wounds than physical weapons
questions.explanation: 'Words cut more than swords' means hurtful words cause deeper wounds than physical weapons. 'Words cut more than swords' ဆိုတာ စကားက ဓားထက် ပိုဖြတ်တယ်။

exercises.instructions: Choose the proverb that best fits the given situation.

questions.question: Your friend is worried about the future. Which proverb should you tell them?
options: The early bird catches the worm
What will be, will be
Easy come, easy go
questions.answer: What will be, will be
questions.explanation: 'What will be, will be' is used to reassure someone that the future is determined and cannot be changed. 'What will be, will be' ဆိုတာ ဖြစ်မည့်အရာက ဖြစ်မှာပဲ။

questions.question: Someone spent all their money on a risky investment. Which proverb describes this?
options: All covet, all lose
Don't look a gift horse in the mouth
More haste, less speed
questions.answer: All covet, all lose
questions.explanation: 'All covet, all lose' means greed causes people to lose everything. Spending all money on a risky investment fits this proverb. 'All covet, all lose' ဆိုတာ တစ်ခုတည်းကို လိုချင်ရင် ဆုံးရှုံးတတ်တယ်။

questions.question: You got a free gift but it has a small defect. Which proverb applies?
options: Don't judge a book by its cover
Don't look a gift horse in the mouth
Easy come, easy go
questions.answer: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth
questions.explanation: 'Don't look a gift horse in the mouth' means do not criticize something given to you for free. 'Don't look a gift horse in the mouth' ဆိုတာ လက်ဆောင်ရတဲ့မြင်းရဲ့ပါးစပ်ကို မကြည့်ပါနဲ့။

questions.question: A team fails because one lazy member doesn't do their work. Which proverb fits?
options: One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch
A friend to all is a friend to none
Might is right
questions.answer: One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch
questions.explanation: 'One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch' means one bad person can negatively influence an entire group. 'One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch' ဆိုတာ ပုပ်သောအသီးတစ်လုံးက အုပ်စုတစ်ခုလုံးကို ပျက်စေတယ်။

questions.question: You should save some money for unexpected expenses. Which proverb tells you this?
options: Make hay while the sun shines
Keep something for a rainy day
Lend only that which you can afford to lose
questions.answer: Keep something for a rainy day
questions.explanation: 'Keep something for a rainy day' means save resources for a time of need. 'Keep something for a rainy day' ဆိုတာ မိုးရွာတဲ့နေ့အတွက် တစ်ခုခုထားပါ။

questions.question: A person who talks a lot but knows very little. Which proverb describes them?
options: Empty vessels make the greatest song
Fools are wise as long as silent
A barking dog seldom bites
questions.answer: Empty vessels make the greatest song
questions.explanation: 'Empty vessels make the greatest song' means people with little knowledge often talk the most. 'Empty vessels make the greatest song' ဆိုတာ အလွတ်ဗူးက အကြီးဆုံးအသံထွက်တယ်။

questions.question: You want to visit a new country and follow their customs. Which proverb applies?
options: When in Rome do as Romans do
Blood is thicker than water
Out of sight, out of mind
questions.answer: When in Rome do as Romans do
questions.explanation: 'When in Rome do as Romans do' means when in a new place, follow the customs of the people there. 'When in Rome do as Romans do' ဆိုတာ ရောမမှာနေရင် ရောမလူတွေလို လုပ်ပါ။

questions.question: Someone is trying to change their fundamental personality. Which proverb warns them?
options: A leopard cannot change its spots
What's done is done
Time cures all ills
questions.answer: A leopard cannot change its spots
questions.explanation: 'A leopard cannot change its spots' means people cannot change their fundamental nature. 'A leopard cannot change its spots' ဆိုတာ လူတစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ မူလသဘာဝကို ပြောင်းလဲလို့မရဘူး။

questions.question: A friend betrayed your trust after being close for a long time. Which proverb fits?
options: Familiarity breeds contempt
A friend to all is a friend to none
Grasp all, lose all
questions.answer: Familiarity breeds contempt
questions.explanation: 'Familiarity breeds contempt' means too much closeness leads to a lack of respect. 'Familiarity breeds contempt' ဆိုတာ ရင်းနှီးမှုက အထင်အမြင်သေးခြင်းကို ဖန်တီးတယ်။

questions.question: You should start working now while conditions are favorable. Which proverb tells you this?
options: Make hay while the sun shines
The longest night will have an end
Time cures all ills
questions.answer: Make hay while the sun shines
questions.explanation: 'Make hay while the sun shines' means take advantage of favorable conditions while they last. 'Make hay while the sun shines' ဆိုတာ နေရောင်ရှိတုန်း မြက်ခြောက်လှပ်ပါ။
